response.speaker: Amber

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: We've been using the same poster at the restaurant for so long. It's high time we got a new one.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: I've been thinking that we could draw passersby in more easily with some beautiful shots of our dishes.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: As the old saying goes: "A fine meal is three parts color, three parts aroma, three parts taste, and one part advertising."

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: ...Of course, I added that last bit myself.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Dad always talks about the first three — it's as common culinary wisdom as can be.

choices.text: Hardworking as always, huh, Xiangling?

response.speaker: Xiangling

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Finding rare ingredients, creating new dishes, learning how to advertise... I've still got a long way to go in my culinary journey.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Haha, now that you mention it, it's been a long time since our first meeting, hasn't it?

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: But many things have stayed the same, too, haven't they? You're still traveling, and I'm still coming up with new dishes.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: It's my goal not only to keep Wanmin Restaurant open, but to make it better and better.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: So long as I've got strength in my arms, I'll be stir-frying and wok-tossing even when I'm an old granny, delivering delicious, piping hot dishes from pot to plate.

response.speaker: Xiangling

dialogues.text: I think you're saying you want to use a Kamera to take photos, but I don't see yours anywhere. Are you sure you brought one?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: The Fortune Slip I received at the Grand Narukami Shrine stated that Great Fortune shall be with me and that I should expect a reunion.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: #It seems the reunion was to be with you. It's been a while, {NICKNAME}.

choices.text: We're here to take pictures of Inazuma City.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Ah, an elegant pursuit. To take pictures of scenery one has witnessed is to remind oneself of one's journey thus far.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What about you, Kazuha?

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: I have presently made plans to meet Mr. Nakanishi at the teahouse to discuss the art of the tea ceremony. He is well-versed in the relevant disciplines, and is a regular there.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Are you an expert too?

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: I studied for a time in my youth, but my knowledge then was quite shallow. I have found it all the more fascinating while revisiting it for study as of late.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: For example, the nations differ in their manifestations of said ceremonies. For Inazuma, we emphasize the spirit of "purity" and "tranquility."

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Liyue's Qiaoying Village also produces tea, and the people of that land lean towards "harmony" and "authenticity."

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: These differences also reflect the two people's differences in living habits. Most fascinating.

choices.text: You're a real lover of learning.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Haha, hardly... In truth, I did not return here solely for that.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: This is the land of my birth, and so it remains, though I was once compelled to leave.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Returning every once in a while, seeing people I knew in my youth, spending time in familiar places...

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: I feel as if I still have roots here, which relieves the cares of my wanderings.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: To use Kameras to immortalize such memories is a wonderful idea. We wanderers need our anchors more than anyone, after all.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Anyway, that's quite enough about me. I don't wish to take up your time, but if you need any aid, simply say the word.

dialogues.text: #Huh? Oh, it's you, {NICKNAME}! What's the plan today?

choices.text: We're here to take some pictures of Sumeru City.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Ah, photography! True, Akademiya researchers often come here to snap a few shots of the city.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Most who do are from Vahumana and Kshahrewar, apparently to study urban infrastructure... and um, architectural history or something like that.

choices.text: Well, aren't you familiar with the Darshans?

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Not... really. I just know about their research fields and how they set their courses up. I'm still a long way from being a real scholar, though.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: But if you wanted me to take the selection exam... Heh, I doubt I'd pass even the first round of the written test.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: I wish I could reach the level of a researcher, of course, but it's still a dream at the moment...

choices.text: You'll make it someday.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: #Thanks so much, {NICKNAME}. Anyway, I'll do my best to learn the basics first!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Honestly, I'm just happy to learn something new every day.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: And right now, my goal is to be the best Forest Ranger I can be.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Guiding those who've gotten lost in the rainforest, helping people who've accidentally ingested poison, protecting the rainforest flora and fauna...

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: We Forest Rangers do lots of things. Everyone needs me, and I'm more than willing to help!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: I've only done a couple of little things here and there, but still, everyone recognizes my work.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Guess I'm lucky to have all these people who care about me... and to have made friends with someone as amazing as you.

response.speaker: Lynette

choices.text: Aye, but they're real slave drivers. Six days of work, one day off.
